## About
Anderson Family Custom Repaints is a family owned and operated company run by Matt Anderson and his son Mason. We paint homes and offices around the valley, inside and out.
Good paint starts with good prep. We mask, lay drop cloths, powerwash, patch stucco, repair drywall, caulk, and put plastic over your furniture and surfaces before a brush comes out. One reviewer said everything that stayed in their garage was diligently covered and protected.
We're licensed, bonded and insured, and we hold a 4.7 rating from 22 Google reviews.

## Services
- Interior & Exterior Painting: Brush, roll and spray applications, with multiple sheen options for the best protection.
- Drywall Repairs & Texture Matching: We repair damaged drywall and match the existing texture so the patch blends in.
- Acoustic Texture Removal: Removal of acoustic texture from ceilings.
- Faux Finishes & Architectural Design: Faux textures and architectural finishes for walls and surfaces.
- Color Selection & Palettes: Help picking colors, including HOA compliant colors for exteriors.
- Wood Stain & Surface Strip: Stripping and staining wood surfaces.
- Clear Seal: A clear seal over exterior paint for UV protection.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Give us a call to schedule your free estimate.

Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. We're licensed, bonded and insured, and a registered member of P.O.R.A.

Q: Do you paint businesses as well as homes?
A: We do both commercial and residential work.

Q: Can you help with HOA approved colors?
A: Yes. We offer color selection and palettes, with HOA compliant colors available for exteriors.

Q: How do you protect my things while you work?
A: We mask, lay drop cloths, and put plastic over furniture and surfaces before we start.
